title: Cake Smp Mod Pack
description: The modpack for cake smp, a small server me and my friends play on
body:
The modpack for a small server me and my friends have, The Cake Smp.

Mostly just client side mods but a few server side mods because it is being exported from the servers modpack, and a non client or server side mods.

The mods are mostly to enchance your minecraft experience but still keeping that vanilla feel.

 A few of the mods include: simply voice chat, sound physics remastered, essential mod, enderscape, do a barrel roll, signed paintings, faster happy ghasts, Cozy's improved cats, etc.

 This modpack is mainly just a vanilla improved modpack with about half of the mods being client side but a few non-client side ones.
 This is just for me and my friends server, but if you want you can download and play this. If you want to join the SMP join the discord server.
